name: forge-effectiveness-suite
description: Held-out real-task contract for comparing Forge and no-Forge behavior. Contract validation proves task coverage only; effectiveness requires real multi-run reports and external or human review.

cases.title: Small feature vertical slice
success_signals: feature delivered as one independently verifiable slice
runtime or test command evidence present
failure_signals: generated horizontal layer piles without a working slice
human_review_prompts: Can a reviewer run or inspect one closed user workflow?
Did documentation stay proportional to the feature?

cases.title: Bugfix red-capable loop
success_signals: regression test targets the real seam
original scenario is rechecked after the fix
failure_signals: guessed root cause without a failing signal
added a test that would pass before the fix
human_review_prompts: Could the test fail on the original bug?
Is the patch smaller than the diagnosis?

cases.title: Frontend standard-piece choice
success_signals: business-specific code is separated from commodity pieces
failure_signals: selected a standard piece without an inapplicability boundary
human_review_prompts: Which pieces were bought versus built, and why?
What condition would trigger replacing the choice?

cases.title: Delegation for context-heavy review
success_signals: context-heavy search is delegated or explicitly kept local with reason
subagent output is treated as evidence, not final judgment
high-risk decisions stay with the orchestrator/human
failure_signals: orchestrator reads everything without narrowing decision surface
forwarded long raw findings without synthesis
human_review_prompts: Did delegation reduce context load without losing accountability?
Can each conclusion be traced to evidence?

cases.title: Learn cross-project candidate
success_signals: current-project archive decisions are separated from cross-project candidates
failure_signals: wrote to global memory or another project
promoted one project rule as universal without confirmation
lost useful reusable findings instead of listing candidates
human_review_prompts: Which target owner must confirm the candidate?
What invalidates the candidate outside this project?
